instruction: Add a Yahoo Mail account to Thunderbird with the provided email ('yahoousername@yahoo.com') and password ('yahoopass456'), continue setup despite any warnings, and complete the process for manual credential verification afterward.

metadata.explanation: Variation 1: Yahoo Mail account setup task. User must configure both IMAP (imap.mail.yahoo.com) and SMTP (smtp.mail.yahoo.com) servers with credentials yahoousername@yahoo.com / yahoopass456. Evaluator uses firefox_decrypt.py to extract saved account credentials from Thunderbird profile and validates both incoming and outgoing mail server configurations are present. Same complexity as original task - requires multi-step account setup with both IMAP and SMTP configuration.
metadata.verification: Task validated against Thunderbird account setup process. Yahoo Mail uses standard IMAP (imap.mail.yahoo.com) and SMTP (smtp.mail.yahoo.com) servers. The check_csv metric will verify both mail server entries exist with correct credentials.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if both IMAP and SMTP accounts are configured correctly with specified credentials, 0.0 otherwise.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses postconfig to extract Thunderbird account credentials after task completion via firefox_decrypt.py
check_csv metric properly verifies both IMAP and SMTP server configurations with correct credentials
Complete coverage: Both incoming mail (IMAP imap.mail.yahoo.com) and outgoing mail (SMTP smtp.mail.yahoo.com) servers are verified
Expected values are correct: yahoousername@yahoo.com / yahoopass456 for both servers
State extraction is robust: firefox_decrypt.py reads saved credentials from Thunderbird profile which persists after setup
Verification logic matches instruction requirements: All aspects of Yahoo Mail account setup are validated
